hooks.command: $branch = git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>$null; $lastCommit = git log -1 --format='%s' 2>$null; $dirty = git status --porcelain 2>$null | Measure-Object -Line | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Lines; $changedModules = git diff --name-only HEAD 2>$null | Where-Object { $_ -match '^apps/[^/]+/feature/' } | ForEach-Object { ($_ -split '/')[0..2] -join '/' } | Select-Object -Unique; $ctx = "Branch: $branch | Last commit: $lastCommit | Uncommitted files: $dirty"; if ($changedModules) { $ctx += " | Changed feature modules: " + ($changedModules -join ', ') }; @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'SessionStart'; additionalContext = $ctx } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress

$j = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($j.tool_input.file_path) { $j.tool_input.file_path } else { $j.tool_response.filePath }; if ($f -match 'apps[/\\][^/\\]+[/\\]feature[/\\]') { @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = 'PostToolUse'; additionalContext = 'Feature module file edited. Invoke dhruv-module-auditor on this module before finishing.' } } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress }

hooks.prompt:
A Gradle test command just ran. The hook input is: $ARGUMENTS

Check tool_response for the exit code. If any tests failed (exit_code != 0), invoke dhruv-debugger with the full error output and failing test names. If all tests passed, output nothing and exit immediately.
